card.name: Partway through split words
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the middle piece of a word that is split up, most clearly 'arr' in 'Diarrhea' within 'Clostridium difficile-Associated Diarrhea'. It also fires on a few body-part or route words like 'neck', 'throat', 'IM' and 'outfield'.

modes.label: Diarrhea split
modes.description: The 'arr' piece inside 'Diarrhea' in the Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhea warning heading.

modes.label: Other word beginnings
modes.description: A noun or abbreviation that is followed by a word ending, such as outfield(er), throat, or IM.
modes.example: Youngstown manager Marty Hogan, a former<< outfield>>er, was an outstanding judge of pitching

card.plain: It mostly marks the spelling-out of 'diarrhea' in C. difficile warnings, plus a few scattered nouns.
